board: Adafruit MPRLS Ported Pressure Sensor Breakout - 0 to 25 PSI (product 3965)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, circuit board, footprint). The model uses the datasheet's 0xAA 00 00 command, a status byte plus 24-bit counts, and transfer function A (10-90 % of 2^24) for 0-25 psi; the driver polls the busy flag and checks the status bits.
breakoutPinoutSource: Adafruit Eagle board file (github.com/adafruit/Adafruit-MPRLS-Pressure-Sensor-Breakout-PCB): JP1 silkscreen left to right VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDA, EOC, RST; schematic shows 10k pull-ups on SDA/SCL to VIN through 2N7002 level shifters
